title: jewelry
description:
Here's your Jewelry Designer — a fully interactive piece creator. Here's what you can do:
Left panel — foundation

Choose from ring, necklace, bracelet, or earring
Pick a metal: yellow gold, white gold, rose gold, silver, or platinum
Select a band style: plain, pavé (gem-studded), twisted, or milgrain (dotted edge)

Right panel — details

Choose a gemstone type (diamond, ruby, emerald, sapphire, amethyst) or go stone-free
Fine-tune the gem color with the color swatches
Add up to 12 characters of engraving (initials, a date, a phrase)
Set your size with the slider

The live preview updates instantly as you design. Hit "Describe this piece ↗" to get a poetic name and description, or "Get a quote ↗" to explore pricing and where to have your design made.
